notes: cælum: plural is cæli/cælos (masculine); the singular is neuter
opus, operis: genitive plural operum, neuter plural opera
caput: genitive plural capitum, neuter plural capita
nomen: genitive plural nominum, neuter plural nomina
flumen: genitive plural fluminum, neuter plural flumina
os, ossis (bone): genitive plural ossium, neuter plural ossa; the spelling os is also os, oris (mouth)
Adam: indeclinable in the Vulgate, but takes a first-declension dative Adæ (v.20)
solus: pronominal adjective — genitive solius, dative soli
uterque: uter declines and -que stays fixed; this -que is not the enclitic 'and'
circuit (v.11) and circumit (v.13) are the same present third singular of circumeo
vado: defective — no perfect or supine in use
